baseline: SQI-FORMAL-20260917-1 (18 sqi cells; analysis only - no new experiments, no frozen asset modified)

method.byte_accounting: deterministic compact JSON (sort_keys, separators) recomputed from sqi-call-log envelopes and events.ndjson
method.productive_payload: evidence bytes whose evidence_id appears in the cell Evaluation Used closure (evaluation-v11.json)
method.duplicate_payload: evidence bytes for an evidence_id already returned by an earlier call in the same session
method.cache_amplification: cache_read_tokens / input_tokens per cell (mechanism: each tool turn re-reads the accumulated context prefix)
method.token_attribution_limitation: claude reports usage per result event, not per cost source; byte-level accounting is exact, token-level split between system prompt / tool schema / history is measurement unavailable and flagged as such

findings.finding: 80.0% of evidence bytes were actually cited by the agent (198,354 / 247,745 B); the payload is NOT mostly redundant. Aggressive evidence stripping would risk the T02/T04 correctness floor.
findings.implication: C1 dedup must not cut uncited-but-returned evidence wholesale; it may only cut structural duplication.

findings.finding: cache_read/input = 15.3x (native 6.5x). Every tool turn replays the accumulated context; sessions with more/leaner calls pay O(n^2)-style replay. T05 (13 calls) 22.6x, T02 18.6x.
findings.implication: the dominant cost lever is FEWER + LEANER tool turns (C2/C3), not byte-shaving alone: an X% envelope cut removes ~X% of every subsequent turn replay.

findings.finding: per-evidence repository+commit = 105 B x 320 entries ~= 34 KB (13.7% of evidence bytes), byte-identical to the envelope header; source_verification_policy 249 B x 59 calls ~= 15 KB; returned_evidence_ids duplicates the evidence id list (~16 KB).
findings.implication: contract-amendment-level dedup (session-header scoping) yields ~65 KB (~12.5%) with zero information loss.

findings.finding: SQI source-read bytes 1.2 MB / 324 events vs native 213 events; source verification is performed in both arms and is not an SQI-specific cost anomaly.
cross-call duplicate evidence is only 7.4% (18.4 KB).
findings.implication: C1 pure dedup alone has a low ceiling; combine with C2 per-call projection and C3 fewer calls.

MUST_KEEP.evidence: task correctness is judged on facts; T04 aggregates and T02 caller rows are the success payload

MUST_KEEP.field: evidence identity (evidence_id, kind, source_id, relation, target_id)
MUST_KEEP.evidence: C1/C2 binding + citation closure + evaluator fact crosscheck
contract-required provenance anchors; source-verification workflow depends on them
harness structured-result extraction and citation-closure oracle (derivable, but removal requires contract amendment - see SAFE_TO_DEDUP note)
protocol budget accounting and truncation-honesty oracle
result-level provenance; commit binding is evaluator-checked
T04 frozen ground truth is judged against these exact aggregates
T02/T03 frozen edge/reference crosschecks rely on it

SAFE_TO_DEDUP.field: per-evidence repository + commit (105 B x 320 entries ~= 34 KB, 13.7% of evidence bytes)
SAFE_TO_DEDUP.evidence: byte-identical to the envelope header within a session; requires contract amendment (per-entry fields frozen in V1)

SAFE_TO_DEDUP.field: source_verification_policy per call (249 B x 59 calls ~= 15 KB)
SAFE_TO_DEDUP.evidence: constant block; belongs at session level; requires contract amendment

SAFE_TO_DEDUP.field: cross-call duplicate evidence entries (18,453 B, 7.4% of evidence bytes)
SAFE_TO_DEDUP.evidence: same evidence_id re-returned by later calls in the same session (T04 13 KB, T05 3.5 KB); bridge can skip re-emitting known ids

ON_DEMAND.field: evidence narrative summary (22,381 B, 9.0% of evidence)
ON_DEMAND.evidence: human-readable text never consumed by evaluator oracles; progressive-disclosure candidate (C3)

ON_DEMAND.field: evidence extras (provenance, confidence, metadata minus fact_id) ~= 60 KB
ON_DEMAND.evidence: not consumed by evaluator or task success; metadata.bundle_role/bundle_profile/distance are ranking-internal

ON_DEMAND.field: full evidence objects for non-cited ids
ON_DEMAND.evidence: evidence-on-demand: ids + compact facts first; detail fetch on demand (C3 mechanism itself)

SAFE_TO_REMOVE.field: none at field level in V1.1
SAFE_TO_REMOVE.evidence: every envelope field is either consumed by an oracle, required by the frozen contract, or measured as productive payload; removals require contract amendments (listed above)
